learning_outcomes.text: Apply acquired knowledge to identify, formulate and solve problems in broad contexts, being capable of integrating them by working in multidisciplinary teams.
Communicate knowledge and conclusions, both orally and in writing, to specialized and non-specialized audiences clearly and unambiguously.
Possess learning skills that allow continuous lifelong learning for adequate professional development.
Organization and planning of projects and human teams. Teamwork and leadership capacity.
Use of the English language at written and oral level.
Ability to defend ideas and viewpoints by indicating pros and cons of different options. Attitudes of critical reasoning and creative actions based on open situations.
Knowledge and capacities to understand the main ideas of complex general and specialized texts.
Ability to relate with English speakers with a sufficient degree of fluency and naturalness.
Attitudes of critical reasoning and creative actions to address and solve problems.
Ability to produce clear and detailed texts on various topics.

syllabus_topics: Trade: Markets, Shipping, Import and Export
assessment_rules: To pass the course, students must obtain a minimum grade of 50% in all evaluations and tests. For the ordinary evaluation, students can opt for a progressive evaluation (Listening Exam 10%, Review 2 10%, Reading Exam 10%, Review 3 20%, TOEIC EXAM 50%) or a global evaluation (TOEIC EXAM 100%). The extraordinary (resit) evaluation consists of the TOEIC EXAM (Listening & Reading) for 100%.
bibliography: Target Score. A communicative course for TOEIC Test preparation Charles Talcott & Graham Tullis. Cambridge University Press. Second edition 2007 / printing 2014. ISBN: 978-0-521-70664-3.
